summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration efforts with Spark, including variant support and DSv2 API upgrades. Additionally, there is an ongoing need for a dedicated specification for table properties and considerations for upcoming patch releases.
highlights: Integration efforts with Spark: variant support and DSv2 API upgrades
Need for a dedicated specification for table properties
Upcoming patch releases for versions 1.11.1 and 1.10.3
Progress on Iceberg Terraform Provider with new features
